description: This file contains shell script functions used for upgrading firmware images on Buffalo devices, including validation, upgrade procedures, and handling specific image formats.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for the device, checking format, size, and compatibility.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs upgrade for TRX + UBI formatted images, erasing firmware and writing the new image.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that decides the upgrade method based on image magic number.
